summary: The dossiers are mostly consistent with the verified current facts: roster, coach, Aspiration penalties, 42-40 record, Cup group, Christmas slate, Specter teams and league dates all match. Errors found were mostly small knowledge-mode slips, chiefly that the Intuit Dome Wall is a seating section rather than standing room, hyphy mislabeled as an LA sound, Hauser & Wirth placed in Culver City, Nipsey Hussle Day dates, and the Drew League venue, all fixed in place. Live searches confirmed Taste of Soul on Oct 17, 2026, found no Pann's closure news, and showed the Drew League venue is not confirmed as Washington Prep. The main strategy problems are plans that assume the Clippers play Cup Nights on Nov 24-25, hex disagreement between navy #12173F and blue #1D428A, and the Washington Prep claim.
